summary: The manuscript establishes three universal structural theorems for arbitrary [[n, 1, d]] CSS codes under uniform coherent Z-rotations: the Universal Even-Odd Parity Dichotomy, the Complete 0-1 Swap-Point Binary Law at theta = pi/4, and Exact-Q polynomial evaluation, formalized in 18 Lean 4 theorems.
weaknesses: Restricted to uniform coherent Z-rotations and k=1 CSS codes.
